rental_minimum_acceptance: Supplier can propose a damage claim with evidence, not unilaterally authorize deduction.
Evidence binds order, vehicle, pickup/return condition, amount/currency, contract-policy version and provenance; reject missing or mismatched evidence.
Customer challenge creates/maintains dispute hold; silence, timeout or supplier assertion alone is not acceptance.
Decision authority is separately authorized and scoped; supplier or claim creator cannot self-adjudicate; cross-tenant actors denied.
C04 records reasoned case decision and authorized amount only; C11 owns money instructions, execution facts, ledger and refund.
Payment facts must bind case, decision revision, order, operation key, amount/currency; no amount derived solely from callback assertions.
Duplicate same command returns prior result; conflicting payload, stale revision, replay and out-of-order completion rejected without double debit/refund.
Unknown external outcome remains unknown and reconciled; never speculative resend.
Appeal or reversal creates linked compensating decision; cannot erase old evidence or rewrite booked money truth.
Before real supplier/PSP integration, tests use synthetic contracts and isolated state; policy absence is explicit external HOLD.
limitations: Static review only; no claim of runtime heartbeat, C13 PASS or C14 PASS.
